faq.title: Jaguar XJ 204PT FAQs
faq.description: Common questions about pricing, warranty, engine identity and fitting for the Jaguar XJ 204PT engine, answered clearly.

faqs.q: How much does a Jaguar XJ 204PT engine replacement cost?
faqs.a: It depends on whether you choose a used, reconditioned or rebuilt engine and whether we fit it. Send your registration and we'll provide an itemised written quote.

faqs.q: Do your 204PT engines come with a warranty?
faqs.a: Yes. Every engine we supply includes a six-month mechanical warranty. We'll explain exactly what's covered and any conditions, including those for outside fitting, before you place an order.

faqs.q: Is the XJ's 204PT an Ingenium engine?
faqs.a: No. The XJ's 204PT is a 240hp unit based on Ford's EcoBoost design. Jaguar's 2.0 Ingenium petrol is a different engine, so we confirm your exact code using the VIN.

faqs.q: Was a 204PT fitted to the 1996 Jaguar XJ?
faqs.a: No. XJ models from that period used six-cylinder and V12 engines. The 204PT appeared in the X351 XJ from 2012, so we always check which engine your car has.

faqs.q: What are common Jaguar XJ 204PT engine problems?
faqs.a: Reported issues include misfires, wastegate rattle, fuel pump faults, cam phaser noise and coolant leaks. Symptoms can overlap, so diagnosis should come before any repair or replacement decision.

faqs.q: Can you deliver a 204PT to my garage?
faqs.a: Yes. Supply-only engines are delivered by pallet across the UK, to homes or independent garages. We confirm compatibility before dispatch and explain warranty conditions for third-party fitting.

faqs.q: What does your XJ supply and fit service include?
faqs.a: At our Grays, Essex workshop we remove the old engine, install the replacement, refill fluids, complete software setup and road test your XJ. Timescales are confirmed when we quote.

workshopIntro.title: Weighing Repair Against Replacement for Your 204PT
workshopIntro.description: Get a reliable diagnosis before deciding anything. Fuel pump faults, coil failures and wastegate rattle can often be repaired without changing the engine. If pre-ignition or overheating has damaged pistons or the head, compare the repair estimate with your XJ's mileage and value.
paragraphs: The Jaguar XJ 204PT engine replacement cost depends on the engine type, its history and whether fitting is included. Labour is a large share of any engine change, so complete supply and fit quotes give the clearest comparison between suppliers.

Some 204PT 2.0 Ingenium petrol engine UK listings mix up engine codes, so confirm whether the seller means the Ford-derived 204PT or an Ingenium unit. Ask about the donor model, mileage and pre-sale checks too.

Warranty matters too. Choosing a Jaguar XJ 204PT engine with warranty provides protection if a mechanical fault develops after fitting. Engines we supply include a six-month mechanical warranty, and we explain the terms and any conditions before you order.

engineProblems.title: Jaguar XJ 204PT Engine Problems to Look For
engineProblems.description: These signs could point to a fault; diagnosis is needed to confirm.

cards.title: Misfire Under Load
cards.description: Stuttering when accelerating or a flashing engine light may relate to coils, spark plugs or carbon deposits on intake valves.
cards.action: Have ignition and intake condition checked.

cards.title: Wastegate Rattle
cards.description: A metallic rattle from the turbo area, especially when lifting off, might suggest a worn wastegate linkage.
cards.action: Book a turbo and boost inspection.

cards.title: Hard Starting or Hesitation
cards.description: Long cranking, stalling or reduced power could indicate low fuel pressure from the in-tank or high-pressure fuel pump.

cards.title: Start-Up Clatter
cards.description: A short clatter after a cold start may be linked to camshaft phaser or timing chain tensioner wear.
cards.action: Arrange a timing system inspection soon.

cards.title: Coolant Going Down
cards.description: A falling coolant level or sweet smell may suggest a leaking water pump, hose or thermostat housing.
cards.action: Book a cooling system pressure test.

cards.title: Knock Under Acceleration
cards.description: A pinging or knocking sound under heavy load could indicate pre-ignition, which needs prompt investigation to protect the pistons.

engineOverview.title: The 2.0 Ti4 Petrol Engine in the X351 XJ
paragraphs: The 204PT is a 1,999cc, four-cylinder turbocharged petrol engine with direct injection, based on Ford's EcoBoost design. In the X351 XJ, badged 2.0 Ti4, it produces 240hp with 340Nm of torque from 2,000 to 4,000rpm, driving the rear wheels through a smooth eight-speed automatic gearbox.

Catalogues list the 204PT in the XJ from 2012, in both standard and long-wheelbase forms, and it continued after the 2015 facelift. That means a Jaguar XJ 204PT engine 1996 search will not match, as the XJ of that era used six- and twelve-cylinder engines.

Likewise, the Jaguar XJ 2.0 Ingenium petrol engine 200hp phrase mixes two engines. The XJ's 204PT is the earlier Ford-derived unit rated at 240hp, while the 200hp Ingenium petrol, usually coded PT204, belongs to newer Jaguar models instead. We confirm yours by VIN.
